title: Garlic and Spring Onion Chicken Sandwiches with Currants and Rocket
changes_from_base: Inspired by a famous roast chicken bread salad: shredded chicken tossed with garlic and spring onion softened in olive oil, vinegar-plumped currants, rocket, toasted nuts and Parmesan, stuffed into baguette with mayonnaise. I roast thighs instead of using a shop rotisserie chicken, and use cider vinegar in place of the original vinegar.
summary: Shredded roast chicken doused in fragrant garlic and spring onion oil with plump currants, fresh rocket and toasted nuts makes a luxurious, warm sandwich.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
pine nuts or flaked almonds, lightly toasted (optional)

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Toss 800 g boneless, skinless chicken thighs with 15 ml olive oil, 1 tsp fine salt and ½ tsp ground black pepper in a roasting tin. Roast for 20-25 minutes until the thickest part reaches 74 °C inside. Let the chicken rest for a few minutes, then shred it into a large bowl and season further to taste.

steps.title: Aromatic oil
steps.text: Heat 90 ml extra-virgin olive oil in a medium frying pan over a medium heat. Add 6 thinly sliced spring onions, 6 thinly sliced garlic cloves and a little salt, then cook, stirring regularly, for 3-5 minutes until the spring onions and garlic are soft and sizzling around the edges. Tip this fragrant mixture into the bowl with the shredded chicken.

steps.title: Currants
steps.text: Add 60 ml cider vinegar and 40 g currants or raisins to the same frying pan and warm over a medium-low heat for 2-3 minutes, stirring gently, until the currants have plumped up. Scrape everything into the chicken bowl and toss together well.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in 40 g rocket leaves, 35 g lightly toasted pine nuts or flaked almonds and 20 g shaved Parmesan if you would like them, then season the whole thing to taste and toss once more.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Slice 1 large baguette into 4 lengths and split each one open, toasting lightly if you prefer.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Spread each half of the bread generously with 1 tbsp mayonnaise or garlic mayonnaise, fill with the warm garlic and spring onion chicken and finish with a generous grind of black pepper.

tips: Soften the garlic and spring onion gently over a low heat and take the pan off as soon as they smell sweet; browned garlic turns bitter.
You can use leftover roast chicken or turkey if you have it to hand; about 450 g of picked meat will work just as well as freshly roasted thighs.
Toast the nuts briefly in a dry pan over a medium heat before adding to the sandwich so they taste warmer and more developed.
Make this sandwich whilst the chicken is still warm from the oven so the heat wilts the rocket and brings out the fragrance of the garlic oil.
storage: Best eaten straight away whilst the chicken is still warm and the rocket is crisp. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
